proposition: Research you can use. Systems you can inspect.
promise: Original science, working technology, accountable operations and useful public services—in one organization.
firstStep: Tell us the outcome you want. We will assess the scope, the right provider, and the terms before any work is agreed.

paths.title: Bring us a problem
paths.detail: Research, engineering, AI operations, governance and practical public services.

paths.title: Buy or use something
paths.detail: A storefront, a multi-provider bazaar, and machine-readable market offers are different ways to participate.

paths.title: Explore a project
paths.detail: Visit worlds, games, tools, experiments and publications from the Group.

paths.title: Follow the work
paths.detail: Read systems-focused reporting and follow current public work at its source.

offers.title: Persistent AI systems
offers.scope: Commission agent workflows, roles, handoffs, review, failure recovery and human oversight.
offers.example: Agent operations and practical team training

offers.title: AI-ready websites and discovery
offers.scope: Improve a business's factual visibility and usability for search, answer engines and authorized agents.
offers.example: GEO/AEO audits, evidence and agent-readable offers

offers.title: Indigenous data governance
offers.scope: Review consent, provenance, authority and CARE-aware use of Indigenous data in technology projects.

offers.title: Software and agent engineering
offers.scope: Convert bounded requirements into testable sites, APIs, interoperable services and automation.

offers.title: Research and formal methods
offers.scope: Investigate complex questions with original models, mathematical methods and source-qualified evidence.

offers.title: Operational reliability
offers.scope: Improve how services are deployed, maintained, repaired and independently checked.

steps.title: Describe the outcome
steps.detail: Tell us what should change, who benefits, and the constraints that matter.

steps.title: Find the accountable provider
steps.detail: The appropriate company assesses the request and its capacity. An inquiry is not an order.

steps.title: Agree on scope and terms
steps.detail: Authority, deliverables, costs, timing and permissions are decided before execution.

steps.title: Receive the useful result
steps.detail: A provider's completion claim is distinct from an accepted outcome.

readers.humans: You can explore without knowing our organizational structure. An inquiry is not a contract.
readers.agents: Public machine endpoints may be inspected without treating their presence as permission to buy, publish or execute.
readers.availability: An HTTP response is a connectivity observation, not proof of a working service or satisfied buyer.
